summary: Attempted to verify mobile responsiveness fixes for Use Cases and 'Kako deluje' sections at 390px, 768px, and 1920px viewports. BLOCKED: The app fails to compile due to a CSS syntax error ('Unclosed block') in /app/frontend/src/styles/Landing.css. Instead of the landing page, the browser renders webpack's 'Compiled with problems' overlay, so no sections are rendered and no responsive behavior can be verified.

failed.issue: Syntax error: Unclosed block. The @media (max-width: 768px) block that starts at line 1545 is missing its closing '}' before the next @media (max-width: 480px) block at line 1825. Brace count: 332 open vs 331 close (diff = 1). Webpack: 'Failed to compile. Syntax error: /app/frontend/src/styles/Landing.css Unclosed block (1545:1)'.
failed.evidence: Frontend supervisor log: 'Module build failed (from ./node_modules/postcss-loader/dist/cjs.js): SyntaxError (1545:1) Unclosed block'. Screenshot on mobile 390px shows the react-error-overlay pointing to Landing.css line 1545 instead of the landing page. Verified at all 3 viewports (390 / 768 / 1920) - none render content because compile fails.

failed.issue: The agent-to-agent context claimed 'CSS syntax error (unclosed block) has been FIXED - duplicate @media blocks merged into single block', but the compile error is still present and identical (line 1545). The fix was not effective.
failed.evidence: grep '^@media' Landing.css shows three top-level @media blocks (1504, 1545, 1825). The 768px block spans 1545-1824 without a closing brace before the 480px block starts.

action_items: Add the missing closing '}' for the @media (max-width: 768px) block in /app/frontend/src/styles/Landing.css. Most likely location: insert '}' between line 1822/1823 (end of .footer-social rule) and line 1825 (@media (max-width: 480px)).

After the fix, re-run mobile responsiveness verification: (1) 390px width -> Use Cases in 1 col, cards 20px padding, icons 48x48, title 18px, subtitle 13px, no horizontal overflow; (2) 390px 'Kako deluje' -> single column, arrows hidden, title 28px, step titles 18px; (3) 1920px desktop regression -> Use Cases 3 cols, Kako deluje 4 cols with arrows visible; (4) 768px breakpoint transition.
